Residential Properties

Commercial Spaces

Our Authority Partners

Approved by Leading Authorities

All our properties are verified and approved by the most trusted development authorities in the region — giving you complete peace of mind.

Noida Development Authority
NDA governs planned development and property approvals across Noida and Greater Noida sectors.
Yamuna Expressway Industrial Development Authority
YEIDA oversees development along the Yamuna Expressway corridor — one of the fastest-growing investment zones in India.
Uttar Pradesh State Industrial Development Authority
UPSIDA promotes industrial and commercial development across Uttar Pradesh with approved land parcels and infrastructure.
